question: Which of the following keywords best defines the existence of more than one level of government in the country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Federalism**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Federalism refers **to the existence of more than one level of government in a country. **
 
• Federalism is a system of government in which power is divided between a central authority and various divisions of the country.
 
• **Generally, a federation has two levels of government.**
 
• **One is the government of the country as a whole**, which is generally responsible for some aspect of national interest.
 
• The rest are governments at the provincial or state level, which take care of most of the day-to-day running of their state.
 
• India, Spain and Belgium are examples of this type of 'holding together' federation. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Totalitarianism**

 
 
• **​**A form of **government where the state seeks to control every aspect of public and private life.**
 
• It **aims for total control over the citizens**, including political, economic, social, cultural, and personal spheres.
 
• **Examples**: Nazi Germany under Hitler, Soviet Union under Stalin, North Korea
 
 
 
• **Dictatorship**
 
 
• **​**A **system of government where a single person or a small group holds absolute power, t**ypically acquired by force or inheritance, without effective constitutional limitations.
 
• **Examples**: Augusto Pinochet in Chile, Saddam Hussein in Iraq.
 
 
 
• **Deliberative Democracy**
 
 
• **​**A **form of democracy that emphasizes the role of discussion and deliberation in decision-making.**
 
• Citizens and representatives engage in rational debate to reach decisions that are well-informed and inclusive.
 
• **Examples**: Town hall meetings, citizen assemblies, participatory budgeting models.
